rationale: The patch changes getChangedFiles from `git status --porcelain --no-renames` to `git diff --name-only HEAD`; the latter omits untracked files, so newly created source files are excluded from fixer change detection. It also removes the try/catch around path resolution, file reading, JSON parsing, and artifact processing, causing those failures to reject the tool call instead of returning the established `{ ok: false, error }` result.
